examples.ko: 추운 날에는 따뜻한 만둣국이 먹고 싶어요.
examples.en: On cold days I want to eat warm dumpling soup.

examples.ko: 설날 아침에 떡국 대신 만둣국을 먹기도 해요.
examples.en: On New Year's morning some people eat dumpling soup instead of rice cake soup.
If you stir an egg into the dumpling soup, it gets softer.
One bowl of dumpling soup here, please.

examples.ko: 만둣국은 만두가 커서 한 그릇이면 배불러요.
examples.en: The dumplings in this soup are big, so one bowl fills you up.
I took care of dinner simply with dumpling soup.

explain: 만두를 넣고 끓인 국이에요. 글자는 'ㅅ'이 있지만 '만둗꾹'처럼 발음해서 'ㄱ'이 된소리로 나요. 떡을 넣으면 '떡국', 둘 다 넣으면 '떡만둣국'이라고 해요.
explain_en: It is a soup boiled with dumplings. The spelling has 'ㅅ' but you pronounce it '만둗꾹', with 'ㄱ' turning tense. With rice cakes it is '떡국', and with both it is '떡만둣국'.

examples.ko: 신입생은 학교생활을 알기 위해서 선배에게 질문해요.
examples.en: New students ask seniors questions to learn about school life.

examples.ko: 학부모 상담 때 담임에게 아이의 학교생활을 자세히 물어봤어요.
examples.en: At the parent meeting I asked the homeroom teacher in detail about my child's school life.
School life is fun, but there is a lot of homework.
At my new school, school life still feels unfamiliar.
Once I made friends, school life became enjoyable.

examples.ko: 학교생활 중에서 소풍이 제일 기억에 남아요.
examples.en: Of all my school life, the field trip is what I remember most.

explain: 학교에 다니면서 겪는 수업, 친구, 행사 같은 전체 생활을 말해요. '학교생활을 하다'보다 '학교생활이 재미있다/힘들다', '학교생활에 적응하다'처럼 자주 말해요. 대학교에서는 '대학 생활'이라고 하는 경우가 많아요.
explain_en: It covers everything about attending school: classes, friends and events. People more often say '학교생활이 재미있다/힘들다' or '학교생활에 적응하다' than '학교생활을 하다'. For university, '대학 생활' is the common phrase.
